Surrey Six Killer's Bid to Overturn Convictions Rejected

Cody Haevischer, convicted in 2014 for six counts of first-degree murder in the October 2007 killings at Surrey's Balmoral Tower, has had his application to stay his convictions rejected. The court's decision means his conviction stands.
